verses.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.pt: Fogem os ímpios, sem que ninguém os persiga; mas os justos são ousados como o leão.
verses.en_web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
verses.en_bbe: The evil man goes running away when no man is after him, but the upright are without fear, like the lion.

verses.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.pt: Por causa da transgressão duma terra são muitos os seus príncipes; mas por virtude de homens prudentes e entendidos, ela subsistirá por longo tempo.
verses.en_web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the sin of the land, its troubles are increased; but by a man of wisdom and knowledge they will be put out like a fire.

verses.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.pt: O homem pobre que oprime os pobres, é como chuva impetuosa, que não deixa trigo nenhum.
verses.en_web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
verses.en_bbe: A man of wealth who is cruel to the poor is like a violent rain causing destruction of food.

verses.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.pt: Os que abandonam a lei louvam os ímpios; mas os que guardam a lei pelejam contra eles.
verses.en_web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have no respect for the law give praise to the evil-doer; but such as keep the law are against him.

verses.en: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.pt: Os homens maus não entendem a justiça; mas os que buscam ao Senhor a entendem plenamente.
verses.en_web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
verses.en_bbe: Evil men have no knowledge of what is right; but those who go after the Lord have knowledge of all things.

verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.pt: Melhor é o pobre que anda na sua integridade, do que o rico perverso nos seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
verses.en_bbe: Better is the poor man whose ways are upright, than the man of wealth whose ways are not straight.

verses.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.pt: O que guarda a lei é filho sábio; mas o companheiro dos comilões envergonha a seu pai.
verses.en_web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps the law is a wise son, but he who keeps company with feasters puts shame on his father.

verses.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.pt: O que aumenta a sua riqueza com juros e usura, ajunta-a para o que se compadece do pobre.
verses.en_web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
verses.en_bbe: He who makes his wealth greater by taking interest, only gets it together for him who has pity on the poor.

verses.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.pt: O que desvia os seus ouvidos de ouvir a lei, até a sua oração é abominável.
verses.en_web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.en_bbe: As for the man whose ear is turned away from hearing the law, even his prayer is disgusting.

verses.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.pt: O que faz com que os retos se desviem para um mau caminho, ele mesmo cairá na cova que abriu; mas os inocentes herdarão o bem.
verses.en_web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone causing the upright to go wandering in an evil way, will himself go down into the hole he has made; but the upright will have good things for their heritage.

verses.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.pt: O homem rico é sábio aos seus próprios olhos; mas o pobre que tem entendimento o esquadrinha.
verses.en_web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.en_bbe: The man of wealth seems to himself to be wise, but the poor man who has sense has a low opinion of him.

verses.en: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.pt: Quando os justos triunfam há grande, glória; mas quando os ímpios sobem, escondem-se os homens.
verses.en_web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.en_bbe: When the upright do well, there is great glory; but when evil-doers are lifted up, men do not let themselves be seen.

verses.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.pt: O que encobre as suas transgressões nunca prosperará; mas o que as confessa e deixa, alcançará misericórdia.
verses.en_web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps his sins secret will not do well; but one who is open about them, and gives them up, will get mercy.

verses.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.pt: Feliz é o homem que teme ao Senhor continuamente; mas o que endurece o seu coração virá a cair no mal.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man in whom is the fear of the Lord at all times; but he whose heart is hard will come into trouble.

verses.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.pt: Como leão bramidor, e urso faminto, assim é o ímpio que domina sobre um povo pobre.
verses.en_web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
verses.en_bbe: Like a loud-voiced lion and a wandering bear, is an evil ruler over a poor people.

verses.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.pt: O príncipe falto de entendimento é também opressor cruel; mas o que aborrece a avareza prolongará os seus dias.
verses.en_web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
verses.en_bbe: The prince who has no sense is a cruel ruler; but he who has no desire to get profit for himself will have long life.

verses.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.pt: O homem culpado do sangue de qualquer pessoa será fugitivo até a morte; ninguém o ajude.
verses.en_web: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
verses.en_bbe: One who has been the cause of a man's death will go in flight to the underworld: let no man give him help.

verses.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.pt: O que anda retamente salvar-se-á; mas o perverso em seus caminhos cairá de repente.
verses.en_web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
verses.en_bbe: He whose ways are upright will be safe, but sudden will be the fall of him whose ways are twisted.

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.pt: O que lavra a sua terra se fartará de pão; mas o que segue os ociosos se encherá de pobreza.
verses.en_web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
verses.en_bbe: By ploughing his land a man will have bread in full measure; but he who goes after good-for-nothing persons will be poor enough.

verses.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.pt: O homem fiel gozará de abundantes bênçãos; mas o que se apressa a enriquecer não ficará impune.
verses.en_web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.en_bbe: A man of good faith will have great blessing, but one attempting to get wealth quickly will not go free from punishment.

verses.en: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.pt: Fazer acepção de pessoas não é bom; mas até por um bocado de pão prevaricará o homem.
verses.en_web: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
verses.en_bbe: It is not good to have respect for a man's position: for a man will do wrong for a bit of bread.

verses.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.pt: Aquele que é cobiçoso corre atrás das riquezas; e não sabe que há de vir sobre ele a penúria.
verses.en_web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
verses.en_bbe: He who is ever desiring wealth goes running after money, and does not see that need will come on him.

verses.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.pt: O que repreende a um homem achará depois mais favor do que aquele que lisonjeia com a língua.
verses.en_web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.en_bbe: He who says words of protest to a man will later have more approval than one who says smooth words with his tongue.

verses.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.pt: O que rouba a seu pai, ou a sua mãe, e diz: Isso não é transgressão; esse é companheiro do destruidor.
verses.en_web: Whoever robs his father or his mother, and says, “It’s not wrong.” He is a partner with a destroyer.
verses.en_bbe: He who takes from his father or his mother what is theirs by right, and says, It is no sin; is the same as a taker of life.

verses.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.pt: O cobiçoso levanta contendas; mas o que confia no senhor prosperará.
verses.en_web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
verses.en_bbe: He who is ever desiring profit is a cause of fighting; but he who puts his faith in the Lord will be made fat.

verses.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.pt: O que confia no seu próprio coração é insensato; mas o que anda sabiamente será livre.
verses.en_web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
verses.en_bbe: He whose faith is in himself is foolish; but everyone walking wisely will be kept safe.

verses.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.pt: O que dá ao pobre não terá falta; mas o que esconde os seus olhos terá muitas maldições.
verses.en_web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives to the poor will never be in need, but great curses will be on him who gives no attention to them.

verses.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.pt: Quando os ímpios sobem, escondem-se os homens; mas quando eles perecem, multiplicam-se os justos.
verses.en_web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
verses.en_bbe: When evil-doers are lifted up, men take cover; but when destruction overtakes them, the upright are increased.
